claim.claim-text: 1. User equipment (102) used for initiating an operation based on a contextual awareness within an automobile, the user equipment comprising:

a no-gating state in which the state machine (2000) is configured to enable the radar system (104) to output indications of the radar-based gestures to the application subscribers; and a soft-gating state in which the state machine (2000) is configured to prevent the radar system (104) from outputting the indications of the radar-based gestures to the application subscribers by shielding the gesture-recognition model (621) from radar data collected by the radar system (104).

2. The user equipment (102) of claim 1, wherein at least one of the context-sensitive transition functions (2008) is configured to receive at least a portion of the inertial sensor data as variable input after filtering the inertial sensor data through a low-pass filter.

3. The user equipment (102) of claim 1 or 2, wherein at least one of the context-sensitive transition functions (2008) is configured to receive an indication of an orientation of the user equipment (102) as variable input and the state machine (2000) is configured to transition between multiple states for controlling the radar system (104) based on the inertial sensor data, the context-sensitive transition functions (2008), and the orientation.

4. The user equipment (102) of claim 1-3, wherein at least one of the context-sensitive transition functions (2008) is configured to receive an indication of proximity from the user equipment (102) to an object as variable input and the state machine is configured to transition between the multiple states for controlling the radar system (104) based on the inertial sensor data, the context-sensitive transition functions (2008), and the proximity.
5. The user equipment (102) of any of claims 1-4, wherein:

a first function from the context-sensitive transition functions (2008) is configured to output a first contextual score indicating whether, based on the inertial sensor data, to transition from the no-gating state to the soft-gating state; and the state machine (2000) is configured to transition from the no-gating state to the soft-gating state in response to determining that the first contextual score satisfies a first threshold.

6. The user equipment (102) of claim 5, wherein the state machine (2000) is configured to transition from the no-gating state to the soft-gating state in response to determining that the first contextual score satisfies the first threshold and the fist contextual score exceeds the second contextual score.

7. The user equipment (102) of any of claims 1-6, wherein at least one of the context-sensitive transition functions (2008) is configured to output a contextual score based on a comparison between a position, orientation, or movement inferred from the inertial sensor data and a position, orientation, or movement threshold.

8. The user equipment (102) of any of claims 1-7, wherein a first function from the context-sensitive transition functions is configured to output a contextual score based on whether the radar system is occluded by an object.

9. The user equipment (102) of claim 8, wherein the state machine (2000) is configured to transition from the no-gating state to the soft-gating state in response to the contextual score indicating that the user equipment (102) is not occluded by the object.
10. The user equipment (102) of any of claims 1-9, wherein the user equipment (102) comprises an automobile.
